theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → ∃ G : (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k) → (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G ∧ G 0 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ G 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (s t : ℝ) (u : Euclid m → Euclid k), (∀ a b, inner ℝ (ι a) (ι' b) = 0) → (∀ z : Euclid P, ∃ a b, z = ι a + ι' b) → 0 < s → 0 < t → IsOpen U → {z : Euclid P | ∃ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ∃ b ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (k)) t, z = y + ι a + ι' b} ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → (∀ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ‖u a‖ < t) → M ∩ {z : Euclid P | ∃ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ∃ b ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (k)) t, z = y + ι a + ι' b} = (fun a => y + ι a + ι' (u a)) '' ball 0 s → (∀ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) s, tangentSpace M (y + ι a + ι' (u a)) = Set.range (fderiv ℝ (fun a => y + ι a + ι' (u a)) a)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0) → (∀ ζ : Euclid m → Euclid k, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid m) s → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid m) s, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (G (fderiv ℝ u x) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))))
